title: Made in Hong Kong (bc30)
synopsis: The first film in Fruit Chan's "Handover Trilogy", this raw, low-budget film tells a story about forgotten youth. With no hope for the future, four teenagers struggle between broken homes and street violence: Moon becomes a street hoodlum; Susan takes her own life after heartbreak; Ping is terminally ill and abandoned by her father; and Sylvester, who has an intellectual disability, is used to smuggle drugs. As tragedy strikes, what remains is a desperate cry against the world that abandoned them.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 陳果「97 三部曲」的首部，以極低成本描繪出城市邊緣早已被遺忘的冷峻成長之歌。沒有希望、看不見明天，四名年輕人在苦苦渴求愛的同時散發出危險不安的躁動、無處安放的絕望，於破碎原生家庭與暴力中掙扎求存。中秋因家庭破裂而淪為街頭流氓；中學生阿珊受情傷後選擇自殺；阿屏患上不治之症，其父欠債後拋妻棄女；智障的阿龍則被利用偷運白粉。這四名問題青年命運多舛，只有中秋活下來向社會作出控訴 ……

cast: Sam Lee Chan-sam, Neiky Yim Hui-chi, Wenders Li Tung-chuen, Amy Tam Ka-chuen
